```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(nhstt)
library(dplyr)
library(crosstalk)
library(leaflet)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

status_levels <- c("Active", "Inactive")
inactive_colour <- "#8a8f93"
status_colours <- colorFactor(
  c("#1d70b8", inactive_colour),
  levels = status_levels
)

# Label for providers ODS has no region for, used in the table and the filters
no_region <- "Unknown"

format_quarter <- function(period) sub("-q", " Q", period)
format_month <- function(period) {
  format(as.Date(paste0(period, "-01")), "%B %Y")
}
popup_line <- function(label, value) {
  paste0("<strong>", label, ":</strong> ", htmlEscape(value))
}

metadata_providers <- get_metadata_providers()

retrieved_date <- format(unique(metadata_providers$retrieved_date), "%d %B %Y")
latest_periods <- c(
  annual = unique(metadata_providers$annual_latest_period),
  quarterly = format_quarter(unique(
    metadata_providers$quarterly_latest_period
  )),
  monthly = format_month(unique(metadata_providers$monthly_latest_period))
)

nhstt_providers <- metadata_providers |>
  mutate(
    region_name = coalesce(region_name, no_region),
    closed = if_else(
      is.na(end_date),
      "",
      paste0("<br>", popup_line("Closed", end_date))
    ),
    popup = paste(
      paste0("<strong>", htmlEscape(org_name), "</strong>"),
      popup_line("Code", org_code),
      popup_line("ODS status", status),
      paste0(popup_line("Open since", start_date), closed),
      popup_line("Town", town),
      popup_line("Postcode", postcode),
      popup_line("ICB", coalesce(icb_name, no_region)),
      popup_line("Region", region_name),
      popup_line("Last annual data", coalesce(annual_last_reported, "None")),
      popup_line(
        "Last quarterly data",
        coalesce(format_quarter(quarterly_last_reported), "None")
      ),
      popup_line(
        "Last monthly data",
        coalesce(format_month(monthly_last_reported), "None")
      ),
      sep = "<br>"
    ),
    in_latest_annual = annual_last_reported %in% annual_latest_period,
    in_latest_quarterly = quarterly_last_reported %in% quarterly_latest_period,
    in_latest_monthly = monthly_last_reported %in% monthly_latest_period
  ) |>
  select(
    org_name,
    org_code,
    status,
    town,
    postcode,
    icb_name,
    region_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    popup,
    starts_with("in_latest_")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(status == "Active"), org_name)

# Same fields as the table search, kept apart so a search cannot match across
# two fields
search_text <- nhstt_providers |>
  select(org_name, org_code, status, town, postcode, icb_name, region_name) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) tolower(coalesce(x, "")))) |>
  tidyr::unite("text", everything(), sep = "\n") |>
  pull(text)

shared_providers <- SharedData$new(
  nhstt_providers,
  key = ~org_code,
  group = "providers"
)
```

> **Note:** This page shows providers as listed by the NHS Organisation Data Service (ODS)[^ods] on `r retrieved_date`. We have not cleaned this data yet, so it has some known issues. For example, some providers are listed as active but have not submitted data recently.

[^ods]: Organisation details come from the [NHS Organisation Data Service (ODS)](https://www.odsdatasearchandexport.nhs.uk/).

```{r}
#| label: map-and-table
# The map interactions are in assets/metadata-providers.js and the styles in
# assets/metadata-providers.css. Region boundaries come from
# update_region_boundaries().
map_interactions <- paste(
  readLines("assets/metadata-providers.js", warn = FALSE),
  collapse = "\n"
)
regions_geojson <- paste(
  readLines("assets/nhs-england-regions.geojson", warn = FALSE),
  collapse = ""
)

# No background tiles, the regions are drawn in map_interactions
provider_map <- leaflet(
  shared_providers,
  height = 600,
  elementId = "provider-map",
  options = leafletOptions(
    minZoom = 6,
    maxZoom = 12,
    # England plus enough margin for a popup to pan into view at the edges,
    # otherwise the map snaps back and cuts the popup off
    maxBounds = list(c(47, -13), c(60, 8)),
    maxBoundsViscosity = 1
  )
) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 6,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillColor = ~ status_colours(status),
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~org_name,
    popup = ~popup,
    # Keep open popups clear of the zoom buttons, legend, and attribution
    popupOptions = popupOptions(
      autoPanPaddingTopLeft = c(55, 110),
      autoPanPaddingBottomRight = c(10, 40)
    )
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    map_interactions,
    data = list(
      key = nhstt_providers$org_code,
      lat = nhstt_providers$latitude,
      lng = nhstt_providers$longitude,
      status = nhstt_providers$status,
      region = nhstt_providers$region_name,
      no_region = no_region,
      search_text = search_text,
      reported = list(
        annual = nhstt_providers$in_latest_annual,
        quarterly = nhstt_providers$in_latest_quarterly,
        monthly = nhstt_providers$in_latest_monthly
      ),
      regions_geojson = regions_geojson,
      status_levels = status_levels,
      status_colours = status_colours(status_levels)
    )
  )

# Footer counts the rows left after the filters and search
provider_count_footer <- JS(
  "function(column, state) {
    var n = state.sortedData.length;
    return n + ' provider' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' shown';
  }"
)

provider_table <- reactable(
  shared_providers,
  elementId = "provider-table",
  class = "provider-table",
  width = "100%",
  searchable = TRUE,
  selection = "multiple",
  onClick = "select",
  highlight = TRUE,
  pagination = FALSE,
  height = 600,
  outlined = TRUE,
  rowStyle = function(index) {
    if (nhstt_providers$status[index] == "Inactive") {
      list(color = inactive_colour)
    }
  },
  columns = list(
    # The footer sits in the tick box column so it starts at the left edge
    .selection = colDef(
      footer = provider_count_footer,
      footerStyle = list(fontWeight = 600)
    ),
    org_name = colDef(
      name = "Provider",
      cell = function(value, index) {
        tagList(
          div(strong(value)),
          div(nhstt_providers$town[index]),
          if (!is.na(nhstt_providers$icb_name[index])) {
            div(nhstt_providers$icb_name[index])
          },
          div(nhstt_providers$region_name[index])
        )
      }
    ),
    # Hidden columns stay searchable so the search box covers every field
    org_code = colDef(show = FALSE, searchable = TRUE),
    town = colDef(show = FALSE, searchable = TRUE),
    status = colDef(show = FALSE, searchable = TRUE),
    postcode = colDef(show = FALSE, searchable = TRUE),
    icb_name = colDef(show = FALSE, searchable = TRUE),
    region_name = colDef(show = FALSE, searchable = TRUE),
    latitude = colDef(show = FALSE),
    longitude = colDef(show = FALSE),
    popup = colDef(show = FALSE),
    in_latest_annual = colDef(show = FALSE),
    in_latest_quarterly = colDef(show = FALSE),
    in_latest_monthly = colDef(show = FALSE)
  )
)

reporting_buttons <- div(
  class = "reporting-buttons",
  span(class = "reporting-label", "Data submitted in"),
  tags$button(
    class = "reporting-button active",
    `data-reporting` = "all",
    "Any period"
  ),
  purrr::imap(latest_periods, \(period, frequency) {
    tags$button(
      class = "reporting-button",
      `data-reporting` = frequency,
      paste0(period, " (", frequency, ")")
    )
  })
)

tagList(
  includeCSS("assets/metadata-providers.css"),
  reporting_buttons,
  div(
    class = "provider-layout",
    div(provider_map),
    div(provider_table)
  )
)
```
